director.text: Hi Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj rectangles, squares aur polygons ka perimeter cricket boundary jaisa naapenge. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
haan, samajh aaya
Cricket ki pitch socho, lagbhag 20 m lambi aur 3 m chaudi. Ek kone se chalo, kinaare-kinaare poori pitch ghoomo aur wapas wahin aa jao. Jitna chale, utna pitch ka parimap hai.
haan samajh gayi

Is triangle ki teen bhujayein hain, 4 cm, 5 cm aur 6 cm. Ek kone par ungli rakho aur kinaare par chalao: pehli bhuja, doosri, teesri, aur wapas usi kone par. Ungli jitna chali, wahi parimap hai. Toh ungli kul kitne cm chali?

director.text: 15 centimetre
Haan, sahi hai, kyunki 4 + 5 + 6 = 15 cm, teeno bhujayein judi, koi nahi chhooti.
aapko virat pasand hai?

haan, woh maine bata diya

Theek hai. Yeh hexagon hai, chhah bhujaon wala. Sab bhujayein barabar hain, par label sirf ek par hai: 5 cm. Baaki par kuch likha nahi, phir bhi woh kinaare ka hissa hain. Parimap mein har bhuja aati hai, likhi ho ya na ho. Poore hexagon ka parimap kitna hua?

director.text: 30 cm hai na

Bilkul sahi, kyunki chhah bhujayein, har ek 5 cm ki: 6 × 5 = 30 cm. Ab yeh rectangle dekho, 6 cm lamba aur 4 cm chauda. Parimap ek dhaaga hai jo kinaare par chalta hai: upar 6, side mein 4, neeche 6, phir 4. Andar ki jagah area hai, woh bilkul alag cheez hai. Kinaare par ek baar dhaaga lapetna hai. Kitna dhaaga lagega?

director.text: bees cm

Haan, bilkul theek. Dekho, dhaaga sirf kinaare par chalta hai: 6 + 4 + 6 + 4 = 20 cm. Phoolon ki ek kyari triangle jaisi hai, uski bhujayein 7 m, 9 m aur 12 m hain. Uske kinaare-kinaare ek baar baad lagani hai. Kitni lambi baad lagegi?
pata nahi, aap batao
Baad kinaare par lagegi, toh teeno bhujayein jodni hain: P = 7 + 9 + 12, kyunki ek bhi bhuja chhooti toh baad mein wahan khaali jagah reh jaayegi.
aapko virat pasand hai?
Ab doosra kadam. Pehle 7 aur 9 jodo: 7 + 9 = 16 m, kyunki do bhujayein ho gayi, teesri abhi baaki hai. Main AI hoon, meri koi pasand nahi hoti. Tumhara favourite kaun hai?
haan, samajh aaya
Ab teesri bhuja bachi, 12 m. 16 mein 12 jodo, kitna hua?
director.card: Ab teesri bhuja bachi, 12 m. 16 mein 12 jodo, kitna hua?

director.text: 28 metre

kal maine cricket khela, sixer maara

haan

Is aayat mein upar aur neeche wali bhuja 10 m ki hai, woh lambai hai. Daayein-baayein wali 6 m ki, woh chaudai. Aamne-saamne ki bhujayein barabar hoti hain. Board par 10 aur 6 ek-ek baar likhe hain, par chakkar lagao toh dono do-do baar milte hain. Yahan tak theek hai?
mujhe lagta hai haan

woh wala ho gaya, aage chalo

Achha. Naya aayat: 12 m lamba, 5 m chauda. Neeche baayein kone se chalo, 12 m aage, phir 5 m upar. Ab tum bilkul saamne wale kone par ho, yaani aadha raasta. Baaki aadha bhi utna hi lamba hai. Isliye parimap = 2 × (lambai + chaudai). Ab 2 × (lambai + chaudai) lagao. Is aayat ka parimap kitna hai?
director.card: Ab 2 × (lambai + chaudai) lagao. Is aayat ka parimap kitna hai?

director.text: mujhe lagta hai 34 m

Bilkul sahi. Dekho, aadha raasta 12 + 5 = 17 m, aur do baar: 2 × 17 = 34 m. Square ki chaaron bhujayein barabar hoti hain, yahan har ek 6 cm. 6 ko chaar baar jodne se achha, seedha 4 × bhuja. Aur jawab ek lambai hai, toh cm mein aayega, square cm mein nahi. Is varg ka parimap kitna hua?
director.card: Is varg ka parimap kitna hua?

Cover aayat hai, toh 2 × (lambai + chaudai) lagao: P = 2 × (24 + 18), kyunki chakkar mein lambai do baar milti hai, chaudai bhi do baar. Yeh kadam samajh aaya?

Bracket pehle: 24 + 18 = 42 cm, kyunki 42 cm aadha kinaara hai, ek kone se saamne wale kone tak. Chalo, aage dekhte hain.
achha
Yeh toh aadha kinaara tha. Poore ke liye 2 × 42 kitna hoga?
